name: Reviewers
description: A collection of Reviewer objects that represents the reviewers of one or more documents. The Reviewers collection contains the names of all reviewers who have reviewed documents opened or edited on a computer.
remarks: Use Reviewers (Index), where Index is the name or index number of the reviewer, to return a single reviewer in the Reviewers collection. This example hides revisions made by the first reviewer in the Reviewers collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Reviewers object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of reviewers in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Reviewer object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position or a String representing the name of the individual object.
